ontology.description: Foundry-style ontology over the public OSHA Injury Tracking Application Form 300A filings. Independent design on public data; not affiliated with Palantir and uses no employer data. Establishment-level objects come from whatever harmonised frame is supplied (the SYNTHETIC fixture by default, the real ITA files when present). Industry, sector, year, flag and peer-group objects come from the committed pipeline outputs.

object_types.description: A physical site that files Form 300A. The unit an EHS manager is accountable for and the unit OSHA inspects.
object_types.backing_dataset: establishment frame (ehs_osha.load.load_ita_300a), latest filing per establishment_id
